answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require every new identity to lock 40 POA for 12 epochs before gaining full voting or earning rights. During that period, a sparrow-sized random panel checks one task per epoch; each proof is sealed with a cipher and must match independently observed work. A failed or duplicated proof burns 10% of the bond, while correct reviews return it and add reputation. The nectar of earned privileges therefore accumulates only after repeated verification, so each fake identity adds a fresh bond and twelve-epoch delay.
